subject: FinServCorp onboarding: access controls implementation & execution plan
body:
From: John Darcy <john.darcy@finservcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finservcorp.com>, Alice Ng <alice.ng@finservcorp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinServCorp onboarding: access controls kickoff

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. As discussed, we want to move fast on the following items so our engineering and security teams can finish review this month:

- SSO (SAML 2.0): we exported our IdP metadata and attached it (finserv_saml_metadata.xml).
- SCIM provisioning: we'll send the attribute mappings (CSV) — we have a few custom attributes for department_code and cost_center.
- IP allowlist: our egress range is 34.52.16.0/22 and 52.10.128.0/20 (will confirm exact CIDRs tomorrow).
- Service accounts: need guidance on naming and key rotation for long-lived machine identities.
- Org policies: retention & role mappings (want RBAC tied to our AD groups).

Procurement is copied on MSA/PO timing. We can sign once the security artifacts are in place; happy to start SCIM mappings in parallel.

Regards,
John Darcy
Director of IT Security
FinServCorp

--

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 09:08 AM PST Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: John Darcy <john.darcy@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinServCorp onboarding: access controls kickoff

John — great, thanks for the metadata. I pulled the file and confirmed our platform accepts the SAML config; a couple of items to align on:

1) Assertion consumer URL(s) we should use: https://api.redwood.com/saml/acs and https://console.redwood.com/saml/acs (we can expose only one if you prefer).
2) NameID format: we prefer persistent NameID / email as a fallback.
3) SCIM attributes: please include employeeNumber, department_code, cost_center, manager_email. Monica is attaching our SCIM mapping template.
4) IP allowlist: confirm whether the CIDRs you sent are fixed IPs for egress or if there will be periodic changes (we can support weekly updates but will need a primary contact).
5) Service accounts: suggested naming convention: redwood-service-<team>-<env> and we recommend 90-day key rotation for any long-lived tokens.

Next steps I propose (timeline):
- Nov 12: FinServ sends SCIM attribute CSV and confirms IP ranges (John)
- Nov 13: Redwood stage provisioning and test SAML (Monica + Engineering)
- Nov 14: Demo tenant validation (John, Alice, Redwood)
- Nov 16: Move to prod once procurement signals go-live

I've attached a short onboarding checklist (stereo checklist inline) and will coordinate internal owners. If that timeline is tight, we can prioritize SAML + IP allowlist first and backfill SCIM.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: redwood_onboarding_checklist.docx (checklist stub)

--

On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 10:02 AM PST Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, John Darcy <john.darcy@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: SCIM mapping + provisioning notes

John / Marissa — attaching the SCIM attribute mapping template. A few implementation notes from Engineering:

- SCIM v2.0, POST /Users provisioning; we accept upserts for user objects.
- Required attributes on first sync: userName, externalId, emails[type=work], active (true/false).
- Custom attributes: department_code (string), cost_center (string), manager_email (string). We will map manager_email to manager.externalId if provided.
- For group sync we recommend syncing groups separately via /Groups; name collisions resolved by externalId.
- Rate limits: onboarding syncs can be batched; please keep to 60 req/min during initial full sync.

Service account guidance:
- Create a service account in your AD with a local alias matching redwood-service-<team>-prod.
- If you need a JSON key, we will generate short-lived tokens via our token broker (recommended) rather than issuing long-lived secret keys.

Attachment: scim_attribute_map.csv

Happy to run a quick runbook walkthrough with your engineer — propose 30 minutes Friday.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Identity Integrations
monica_patel@redwood.com

--

We also need SOC 2 Type II evidence (report or letter) and a pointer to any penetration test summary for procurement. Procurement is asking for a redline-friendly DocuSign link for our MSA — I can sign as soon as we have standard security artifacts.

Thanks,
John

Subject: FinServCorp: final access-controls handoff & owners (next steps)

John / Alice — thanks for routing the SCIM CSV and confirming the IP ranges. Below is the execution plan and owners; please reply with confirmations or any adjustments by EOD Monday so we can keep the Nov 16 target.

Execution summary (owners & ETA):
- SAML config applied to staging: Monica (Nov 13) — COMPLETED
- SAML test & assertion review with FinServ: John + Alice (Nov 14) — COMPLETED
- SCIM full sync to staging (test users): Monica (Nov 14) — COMPLETED
- IP allowlist added to staging: Engineering (Monica coordinating) (Nov 14) — COMPLETED
- Prod cutover: Marissa / Laura to coordinate with Procurement (target Nov 16) — PENDING
- MSA / Procurement signoff: Procurement + Ben Carter (legal) — need DocuSign redline (John — can you provide signed pointer?)
- SOC2 evidence: Redwood security to provide SOC2 letter and penetration summary to Procurement (attached link in Confluence).

Action items for FinServCorp:
1) Confirm procurement contact will accept DocuSign (we have link: https://docusign.com/session/abc123).
2) Confirm the exact user who will manage IP allowlist updates (name + email).
3) Send final confirmation once procurement completes signature; Redwood will schedule the prod cutover window (we recommend off-peak after 18:00 PST).

Attachments included for reference: finserv_saml_metadata.xml, scim_attribute_map.csv, redwood_onboarding_playbook.pdf

Links: Implementation checklist (https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ONBOARD/FinServCorp+Implementation+Checklist) | Deal record (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/RED-23456)

If you prefer, Monica and I can join procurement's call to walk through the SOC2/pen test package and the minimal scoping items.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting you fully onboarded.

Best,
Marissa Cole
